events.title: Barra da Tijuca Food and Drinks Tour!

description.pt: Rio de Janeiro Food and History Welcome to the beautiful neighborhood of Barra da Tijuca, one of Rio de Janeiro's best zones for beaches, bars, and restaurants. In this tour we will explore some of the most iconic…

events.descricao_completa:
Rio de Janeiro Food and History
Welcome to the beautiful neighborhood of Barra da Tijuca, one of Rio de Janeiro's best zones for beaches, bars, and restaurants. In this tour we will explore some of the most iconic parts of Barra, such as Jardim Oceânico (or Oceanic Garden, and you will soon realize why it is called like this) and the Gigóia Islands, a hidden treasure, considered as Rio de Janeiro's very own Pantanal, where you might get the chance to spot capybaras and crocodiles. All this while exploring the bars for food and drinks around the area!
As we walk around the beach front, we will cross into Olegário Maciel Avenue, a bohemian, gastronomic hub in Barra. There, customers will be able to indulge from a plethora of dishes according to different regions of Brazil and historical periods, such as feijoada, picanha (rump steak), medalhão com arroz à piamontese, galinha à caipira, carne de sol com aipim na manteiga (sun-dried meat with yucca soaked in butter); or, for the more adventurous, chicken hearts skewers, alongside popular snacks such as queijo coalho and coxinha de galinha, besides much more depending on one´s hunger.
From Olegário Maciel, we continue our march to the ferries and visit the Gigóia Islands, a picturesque part of Rio de Janeiro, often known as the Pantanal (swamps) of the south. The islands also feature many bars and restaurants, where the customers can finish the tour with a refreshing caipirinha or two.
Important notice: there is a small fee for crossing the island (4 reais each way, to be paid exclusively in cash). Food and drinks costs are also extra!
The tour is NOT suitable for vegetarians or vegans (if you want to do the tour but your friend is a vegetarian - vegan, he or she is welcome to tag along and order whatever pleases, but none of those dishes are related to a historical background). The standard tour contains beef, pork and alcohol!
The average lenght of the tour is 3 hours, but be aware that during the peak summer months the restaurants can be quite busy. I do have an agreement with them to serve my group as quickly as possible, but it is beyond my powers when they are very busy during the weekends or holidays. Expect some tours to last 3:30 hours in high season months.
NO HAY TOUR EN ESPAÑOL! Sorry, the tour is already over 3 hours long. There is no remote possibility for me to translate everything I say. Cheers.

events.descricao_completa:
Rio Speaks English
*Em português:*
Um encontro presencial e descontraído para praticar inglês de verdade, todo sábado de manhã, no coração de Botafogo. A cada semana escolhemos um tema para puxar a conversa — mas o foco é conversar, se soltar e conhecer gente nova.

Todos os níveis são bem-vindos, do avançado ao iniciante. Não tem prova, não tem pressão — é só uma mesa amigável onde todo mundo se ajuda. Se você está aprendendo inglês, aqui é o lugar para finalmente falar sem medo de errar.

Anfitrião: Murillo, com Jader como co-anfitrião.

📍 Onde: Café no 2º andar da Livraria Travessa, Botafogo
🕥 Quando: Todo sábado, 10h30 – 12h00
👥 Vagas: Até 16 pessoas
☕ Valor: R25 (Pix ou dinheiro) / R30 (cartão), pago no local

Entre no nosso grupo do WhatsApp!

👉 **Link do grupo:** https://chat.whatsapp.com/JRCxwCcTb9eFn9RSI9rCIa?s=cl&p=a&ilr=4

*In English:*
Join us for a relaxed, in-person English conversation meetup in the heart of Botafogo. Each week we pick a theme — culture, travel, ideas, life in Rio, whatever gets us talking — and dive into a real conversation. The goal isn't a lesson; it's practice, connection, and a good excuse to meet interesting people.

All levels are welcome, from confident speakers to nervous beginners. There's no test and no pressure — just a friendly table where everyone helps each other out. We wander off-topic, we laugh, and the weekly themes are simply there to break the ice.

Locals and foreigners mix equally here. If you're learning English, it's a safe space to actually speak it. If you're new to Rio, it's a great way to meet Cariocas and make friends.

Your host is Murillo, with Jader co-hosting and stepping in when needed.

📍 Where: Café on the 2nd floor of Livraria Travessa, Botafogo
🕥 When: Every Saturday, 10:30 AM – 12:00 PM
👥 Group size: Up to 16 people

*Em português:*
Um encontro presencial e descontraído para praticar inglês de verdade, todo sábado de manhã, no coração de Botafogo. A cada semana escolhemos um tema para puxar a conversa — mas o foco é conversar, se soltar e conhecer gente nova.

*In English:*
Join us for a relaxed, in-person English conversation meetup in the heart of Botafogo. Each week we pick a theme — culture, travel, ideas, life in Rio, whatever gets us talking — and dive into a real conversation. All levels are welcome, from confident speakers to nervous beginners. There's no test and no pressure — just a friendly table where everyone helps each other out. We wander off-topic, we laugh, and the weekly themes are simply there to break the ice.

Locals and foreigners mix equally here. If you're learning English, it's a safe space to actually speak it. If you're new to Rio, it's a great way to meet Cariocas and make friends.

Your host is Murillo, with Jader co-hosting and stepping in when needed.

👥 Group size: Up to 16 people
